$comment: Editorial layer for the public atlas. Keyed by permanent campus id (slug + state). Edit this file, not build_data.py. 'sourceUrls' are curated citations added on top of queue evidence URLs; 'overrides' replace generated fields; 'summary' is visitor-facing text.

birmingham-southern-college-al.name: Birmingham–Southern College
birmingham-southern-college-al.summary: After closing in 2024, the Birmingham campus moved from private liberal arts college to federal training infrastructure, with the U.S. Coast Guard opening TRACEN Birmingham-Southern in 2026.

green-mountain-college-vt.name: Green Mountain College
green-mountain-college-vt.summary: Closed in 2019, the Poultney campus was bought at auction by private owner Raj Bhakta in 2020; by 2026, his redevelopment plan had stalled and the site was again being offered or repositioned.

notre-dame-college-oh.name: Notre Dame College
notre-dame-college-oh.summary: Notre Dame College closed in 2024. In 2026, Akron Children's Hospital emerged as the auction winner for the South Euclid campus, pointing the site toward pediatric specialty care.

college-of-saint-rose-ny.name: College of Saint Rose
college-of-saint-rose-ny.summary: The College of Saint Rose closed in 2024. Albany County's Pine Hills Land Authority then moved to acquire and redevelop the Albany campus as a public authority project.

wells-college-ny.name: Wells College
wells-college-ny.summary: Wells closed in 2024. A proposed Hiawatha Institute Indigenous college reuse became disputed in 2026 after Wells said the sale would not move forward, leaving the campus status unresolved.

overrides.transformation: Proposed Indigenous educational reuse under contested sale

fontbonne-university-mo.name: Fontbonne University
fontbonne-university-mo.summary: Fontbonne wound down instruction through summer 2025. Washington University acquired the 16-acre Clayton campus and leased it back during the closure runway, with long-term use still unsettled.

cabrini-university-pa.name: Cabrini University
cabrini-university-pa.summary: Cabrini closed after the 2023-24 academic year. Villanova assumed ownership of the 112-acre Radnor property and began converting it into Villanova University Cabrini Campus.

medaille-university-ny.name: Medaille University
medaille-university-ny.summary: Medaille closed in 2023. The Buffalo campus sold to Charter Schools Development Corporation for Buffalo Academy of Science Charter School, turning university buildings into a charter-school campus.

cardinal-stritch-university-wi.name: Cardinal Stritch University
cardinal-stritch-university-wi.summary: The Fox Point campus is classified here as a religious and K-12 reuse after Cardinal Stritch's 2023 closure, moving Catholic higher-education property into private school conversion.

cazenovia-college-ny.name: Cazenovia College
cazenovia-college-ny.summary: After Cazenovia closed in 2023, its campus fragmented into mixed redevelopment, municipal ownership, and private reuse instead of remaining one college property.

presentation-college-sd.name: Presentation College
presentation-college-sd.summary: Presentation College's Aberdeen campus is tracked as a parcelized afterlife, with municipal and other buyers dividing a former Catholic health-oriented college footprint.

finlandia-university-mi.name: Finlandia University
finlandia-university-mi.summary: Finlandia's 2023 closure produced a civic and nonprofit fragmentation case, with pieces of the Hancock campus absorbed by various local groups.

mount-ida-college-ma.name: Mount Ida College
mount-ida-college-ma.summary: Mount Ida's 2018 closure converted the Newton campus into a public university asset when UMass Amherst took control.

pine-manor-college-ma.name: Pine Manor College
pine-manor-college-ma.summary: Pine Manor's 2020 merger folded the Brookline campus into Boston College, marking an elite institutional absorption.

wheelock-college-ma.name: Wheelock College
wheelock-college-ma.summary: Wheelock's 2018 merger with Boston University turned a small specialized college into part of a larger urban university system.

newbury-college-ma.name: Newbury College
newbury-college-ma.summary: After Newbury closed in 2019, Welltower moved the Brookline campus toward senior living, shifting educational property into housing infrastructure.

marlboro-college-vt.name: Marlboro College
marlboro-college-vt.summary: Marlboro's 2020 closure left the Vermont campus to an arts and music reuse under Marlboro Music.

burlington-college-vt.name: Burlington College
burlington-college-vt.summary: Burlington College's 2016 collapse led to property liquidation and developer or bank control, making the campus a speculative real estate case.

marygrove-college-mi.name: Marygrove College
marygrove-college-mi.summary: Marygrove's 2019 closure produced a community educational redevelopment model led by the Marygrove Conservancy in Detroit.

dowling-college-ny.name: Dowling College
dowling-college-ny.summary: Dowling's 2016 closure sent the Oakdale estate through auction and redevelopment, parcelizing a historic campus.

urbana-university-oh.name: Urbana University
urbana-university-oh.summary: Urbana closed in 2020 and entered private redevelopment marketing, a speculative afterlife for a regional campus.

atlantic-union-college-ma.name: Atlantic Union College
atlantic-union-college-ma.summary: Atlantic Union's South Lancaster campus is tracked as slow parcel liquidation under religious ownership after its 2018 closure marker.

concordia-university-portland-or.name: Concordia University Portland
concordia-university-portland-or.summary: After Concordia University Portland closed in 2020, the University of Oregon acquired the campus for public university use.

holy-names-university-ca.name: Holy Names University
holy-names-university-ca.summary: Holy Names closed in 2023 and sold its Oakland hills campus to BH Properties, moving the site into investment ownership and leasing or redevelopment scenarios.

marymount-california-university-ca.name: Marymount California University
marymount-california-university-ca.summary: After Marymount California ceased operations in 2022, UCLA acquired its Rancho Palos Verdes and San Pedro sites to expand teaching, learning, and housing capacity.

macmurray-college-il.name: MacMurray College
macmurray-college-il.summary: MacMurray's 2020 closure culminated in a campus auction split into 18 tracts, a parcelized end to a 174-year college.

becker-college-ma.name: Becker College
becker-college-ma.summary: Becker's 2021 closure produced a split municipal and housing afterlife: Leicester acquired campus properties, with some buildings later used for emergency family housing.

college-of-new-rochelle-ny.name: College of New Rochelle
college-of-new-rochelle-ny.summary: The College of New Rochelle entered bankruptcy and auction after its 2019 closure, leaving an urban campus fragmented across buyers.

alderson-broaddus-university-wv.name: Alderson Broaddus University
alderson-broaddus-university-wv.summary: Alderson Broaddus closed in 2023 and moved through bankruptcy sale to CGP Construction and Battlers Knob, shifting the Philippi campus into private redevelopment and community use.

daniel-webster-college-nh.name: Daniel Webster College
daniel-webster-college-nh.summary: After the ITT-linked 2017 closure, Daniel Webster's Nashua campus went through auction sale to Xinhua Education, a speculative institutional reuse case.

virginia-intermont-college-va.name: Virginia Intermont College
virginia-intermont-college-va.summary: Virginia Intermont's Bristol campus is tracked as a ruin and absentee ownership case after the 2014 closure, with the physical site unresolved.

southern-vermont-college-vt.name: Southern Vermont College
southern-vermont-college-vt.summary: Southern Vermont College's 2019 closure led to health and resort redevelopment under Southwestern Vermont Health Care, repurposing the Bennington campus beyond higher education.

st-gregory-s-university-ok.name: St. Gregory's University
st-gregory-s-university-ok.summary: St. Gregory's 2017 closure moved the Shawnee campus into corporate ownership under Hobby Lobby, marking a private institutional acquisition.

gwu-virginia-science-and-technology-camp.name: GWU Virginia Science & Technology Campus
gwu-virginia-science-and-technology-camp.summary: GW's Ashburn campus was sold in 2026 to Amazon Data Services; academic programs can remain temporarily while the land enters cloud-infrastructure redevelopment pressure.
